'''Biodegradable Binders''' were manufactured by the [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]]. Constructed of high-strength [[Polymer/Legends|polymer]]s, they did not feature a traditional locking mechanism, instead employing a one-way clasp that sealed once locked. The binders would then deteriorate in thirty-six [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]], although use of a molecular solvent would degrade the binders sooner if needed.<ref name="HSCS" />
